market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Crude oil has settled at or below $40 multiple times in the last two decades (2008-09, 2014-16, 2020), implying a non-trivial recurring tail event probability exceeding the market's 1.1%. Current elevated economic uncertainty and potential supply overhang make a revisit to $40 within ~17 months more likely than the market implies.
evidence_points: WTI front-month settlement was ≤$40 in 2008-09, 2014-16, and 2020, suggesting a roughly 5-10% annual probability of hitting such levels.
Macro conditions today feature trade war risks and softening global demand which historically have triggered large oil price slides.
OPEC+ spare capacity and potential unwinding of production cuts could amplify any downside move.
